BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to nonambulatory livestock; adding a new section toTitle 16 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to Title 16 RCW toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the purposes of this section, "nonambulatory livestock"means cattle, sheep, swine, goats, horses, mules, or other equine, thatare unable to stand and walk unassisted. (2) A person commits the crime of trading in nonambulatorylivestock if the person knowingly delivers or accepts delivery of livenonambulatory livestock. This section does not apply to: (a) The movement of nonambulatory livestock under the care of alicensed veterinarian, including the delivery of nonambulatorylivestock to a licensed veterinarian, or acceptance of nonambulatorylivestock by a licensed veterinarian, for the purpose of euthanizing orproviding appropriate medical care or treatment to nonambulatorylivestock; and (b) The movement of nonambulatory livestock to provide for the p. 1 SB 6408appropriate care, medical treatment, or euthanizing of animals on afarm. (3) A person convicted of violating this section is guilty of amisdemeanor punishable as provided in RCW 9A.20.021.
